title: Source: Google plans to release a screenless Fitbit band later this year; it will include basic features and require a paid subscription for more functionality (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
summary: Samantha Kelly / Bloomberg: Source: Google plans to release a screenless Fitbit band later this year; it will include basic features and require a paid subscription for more functionality — Alphabet Inc.'s Google is developing its own fitness band, aiming to compete with screenless wearable devices from upstarts like Whoop Inc. and Oura Health Oy.
